status: Review comparison only; no allocation adopted and no workbook changed. W5 is allowed by the guide where applicability is evidenced; compare target-label representativeness and current catch-first assumption route. A different PPR does not prove improvement.
review_question: Are the7identified-lineage regional catch proxies adequately supported under W5, or should the current complete-model-catch assumption hierarchy apply?

items.current_reason: The named lineage spans the source compartments; use identified regional members as a composition proxy, rather than assign the whole label to one guild. Retained weights use identified, singly assigned total catch within this lineage in Arabian Sea 1950–2019. Its observed mix is assumed for the coarse label and held fixed across years/bases.
